overview: Based on the published agenda, this special meeting of the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to consider personnel matters including appointments, separations, leaves of absence, and retirements through a consent agenda process. The meeting represented a streamlined session focused on staffing and human resources actions for the district.

agenda.item: II.A. Appointments (Additional Staff, Replacement Staff, Contract Increases)

discussions.body: The board was expected to consider approval of a consent agenda encompassing multiple personnel categories. The consent agenda included attachments last modified on 8/20/2026 and an addendum modified on 8/24/2026, covering staffing appointments, separations, leaves of absence, and retirements as distinct action items.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to vote on approval of the consent agenda
Action was requested for consideration of staff appointments, including additional staff, replacement staff, and contract increases
Action was requested for consideration of separations, including resignations, contract decreases, and terminations
Action was requested for consideration of leaves of absence
Action was requested for consideration of retirements
title: Special Meeting - 2026-08-24
